034public class ShroudedThunderheadHullmod extends HumanShipShroudedHullmod {
035        
036        public static float MAX_RANGE = 3000f;
037        
038        public static float RECENT_HIT_DUR = 5f;
039        public static float MAX_TIME_SINCE_RECENT_HIT = 0.1f;
040        public static float WEIGHT_PER_RECENT_HIT = 1f;
041        public static float MIN_TOTAL_RECENT_HIT_WEIGHT = 20f;
042        public static float MAX_TOTAL_RECENT_HIT_WEIGHT = 100f;
043        public static float MISFIRE_WEIGHT = 100f;
044        
045        public static float MIN_REFIRE_DELAY = 0.22f;
046        public static float MAX_REFIRE_DELAY = 0.44f;
047        public static float REFIRE_RATE_MULT = 1f;
048
049        public static float FLUX_PER_DAMAGE = 1f;
050        public static float MIN_DAMAGE = 200f;
051        public static float MAX_DAMAGE = 500f;
052        public static float EMP_MULT = 2f;

054        public static class ShroudedThunderheadDamageDealtMod implements DamageDealtModifier {
055                public ShipAPI ship;
056                public ShroudedThunderheadDamageDealtMod(ShipAPI ship) {
057                        this.ship = ship;
058                }
059                public String modifyDamageDealt(Object param,
060                                                                                CombatEntityAPI target, DamageAPI damage,
061                                                                                Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit) {
062                        if (param instanceof DamagingProjectileAPI) {
063                                DamagingProjectileAPI proj = (DamagingProjectileAPI) param;
064                                DamagingExplosionSpec spec = proj.getExplosionSpecIfExplosion();
065                                if (spec != null && spec.getCollisionClassIfByFighter() == CollisionClass.GAS_CLOUD) {
066                                        return null;
067                                }
068                        } else if ((damage.isDps() && !damage.isForceHardFlux()) || damage.getDamage() <= 0f) {
069                                return null;
070                        }
071                        
072                        if (target != null) {
073                                ShroudedThunderheadHullmodData data = getData(ship);
074                                RecentHitData hit = new RecentHitData();
075                                hit.param = param;
076                                hit.target = target;
077                                hit.point = new Vector2f(point);
078                                hit.damage = damage;
079                                hit.shieldHit = shieldHit;
080                                //data.recentHits.add(hit, 1.5f);
081                                data.recentHits.add(hit, RECENT_HIT_DUR);
082                        }
083                        return null;
084                }
085        }

090                ship.addListener(new ShroudedThunderheadDamageDealtMod(ship));
091        }

103        public static String DATA_KEY = "core_ShroudedThunderheadHullmod_data_key";
104        public static class RecentHitData {
105                Object param;
106                CombatEntityAPI target;
107                Vector2f point;
108                DamageAPI damage;
109                boolean shieldHit;
110        }
111        public static class ShroudedThunderheadHullmodData {
112                float untilArc = 0f;
113                TimeoutTracker<RecentHitData> recentHits = new TimeoutTracker<RecentHitData>();
114
115                boolean hasRecentEnoughHits() {
116                        for (RecentHitData curr : recentHits.getItems()) {
117                                float remaining = recentHits.getRemaining(curr);
118                                if (remaining >= RECENT_HIT_DUR - MAX_TIME_SINCE_RECENT_HIT) return true;
119                        }
120                        return false;
121                }
122                
123                // this is only used for how much the shroud glows, not ACTUALLY the hit probability
124                float getHitProbability() {
125                        float recent = recentHits.getItems().size() * WEIGHT_PER_RECENT_HIT;
126                        if (recent > MAX_TOTAL_RECENT_HIT_WEIGHT) {
127                                recent = MAX_TOTAL_RECENT_HIT_WEIGHT;
128                        }
129                        return recent / (recent + MAX_TOTAL_RECENT_HIT_WEIGHT * 0.5f);
130                }
131                
132                RecentHitData pickRecentHit() {
133                        if (!hasRecentEnoughHits()) return null;
134                        WeightedRandomPicker<RecentHitData> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<>();
135                        float totalHitFrequency = recentHits.getItems().size() * WEIGHT_PER_RECENT_HIT;
136                        if (totalHitFrequency < MIN_TOTAL_RECENT_HIT_WEIGHT) {
137                                totalHitFrequency = MIN_TOTAL_RECENT_HIT_WEIGHT;
138                        }
139                        if (totalHitFrequency > MAX_TOTAL_RECENT_HIT_WEIGHT) {
140                                totalHitFrequency = MAX_TOTAL_RECENT_HIT_WEIGHT;
141                        }
142                        for (RecentHitData curr : recentHits.getItems()) {
143                                float remaining = recentHits.getRemaining(curr);
144                                if (remaining < RECENT_HIT_DUR - MAX_TIME_SINCE_RECENT_HIT * 2f) continue;
145                                picker.add(curr, 1f);
146                        }
147                        float numRecentEnoughHits = picker.getItems().size();
148                        if (numRecentEnoughHits > 0f) {
149                                for (int i = 0; i < picker.getItems().size(); i++) {
150                                        picker.setWeight(i, totalHitFrequency / numRecentEnoughHits);
151                                }
152                        }
153                        RecentHitData misfire = new RecentHitData();
154                        picker.add(misfire, MISFIRE_WEIGHT);
155                        return picker.pick();
156                }
157        }
158        
159        public static ShroudedThunderheadHullmodData getData(ShipAPI ship) {
160                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
161                String key = DATA_KEY + "_" + ship.getId();
162                ShroudedThunderheadHullmodData data = (ShroudedThunderheadHullmodData) engine.getCustomData().get(key);
163                if (data == null) {
164                        data = new ShroudedThunderheadHullmodData();
165                        engine.getCustomData().put(key, data);
166                }
167                return data;
168        }
169        
170        @Override
171        public void advanceInCombat(ShipAPI ship, float amount) {
172                super.advanceInCombat(ship, amount);
173                
174                if (!ship.isAlive()) return;
175                if (amount <= 0f) return;
176                
177                ShroudedThunderheadHullmodData data = getData(ship);
178                
179                
180                float prob = data.getHitProbability();
181                DwellerShroud shroud = DwellerShroud.getShroudFor(ship);
182                if (shroud == null) return; // failsafe
183                shroud.getParams().flashProbability = Math.min(0.1f + prob * 1.4f, 1f);
184                //shroud.getParams().alphaMult = 0.5f; 
185                
186                data.untilArc -= amount * REFIRE_RATE_MULT;
187                if (data.untilArc <= 0f) {
188                        boolean hasRecentHits = data.hasRecentEnoughHits();
189                        if (hasRecentHits) {
190                                RecentHitData hit = data.pickRecentHit();
191                                if (hit != null && hit.target != null) {
192                                        data.recentHits.remove(hit);
193                                        spawnLightning(ship, hit);
194                                }
195                                data.untilArc = MIN_REFIRE_DELAY + (float) Math.random() * (MAX_REFIRE_DELAY - MIN_REFIRE_DELAY);
196                        }
197                }
198                
199                data.recentHits.advance(amount);
200        }
201        
202        public static float getPowerMult(HullSize size) {
203                switch (size) {
204                case CAPITAL_SHIP: return 1f;
205                case CRUISER: return 0.6666666667f;
206                case DESTROYER: return 0.3333333333f;
207                case FIGHTER:
208                case FRIGATE:
209                        return 0f;
210                }
211                return 1f;
212        }
213        
214        public static float getDamage(HullSize size) {
215                float mult = getPowerMult(size);
216                return MIN_DAMAGE + (MAX_DAMAGE - MIN_DAMAGE) * mult;   
217        }
218        public static float getEMPDamage(HullSize size) {
219                return getDamage(size) * EMP_MULT;      
220        }
221        public static float getFluxCost(HullSize size) {
222                return getDamage(size) * FLUX_PER_DAMAGE;       
223        }
224        
225        public void spawnLightning(ShipAPI ship, RecentHitData hit) {
226                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
227                
228                Vector2f from = ship.getLocation();
229                Vector2f point = hit.point;
230
231                float dist = Misc.getDistance(from, point);
232
233                if (dist > MAX_RANGE) return;
234                
235                float mult = getPowerMult(ship.getHullSize());
236                float damage = getDamage(ship.getHullSize());
237                float emp = getEMPDamage(ship.getHullSize());
238                
239                if (FLUX_PER_DAMAGE > 0f) {
240                        float fluxCost = getFluxCost(ship.getHullSize());
241                        if (!deductFlux(ship, fluxCost)) {
242                                return;
243                        }
244                }
245                
246                DwellerShroud shroud = DwellerShroud.getShroudFor(ship);
247                if (shroud != null) {
248                        float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(ship.getLocation(), point);
249                        from = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle + 90f - 180f * (float) Math.random());
250                        from.scale((0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.25f) * shroud.getShroudParams().maxOffset * shroud.getShroudParams().overloadArcOffsetMult);
251                        Vector2f.add(ship.getLocation(), from, from);
252                }
253                
254                
255                float arcSpeed = RiftLightningEffect.RIFT_LIGHTNING_SPEED;
256                
257                EmpArcParams params = new EmpArcParams();
258                params.segmentLengthMult = 8f;
259                params.zigZagReductionFactor = 0.15f;
260                //params.fadeOutDist = ship.getCollisionRadius() * 0.5f;
261                params.fadeOutDist = 50f;
262                params.minFadeOutMult = 10f;
263//              params.flickerRateMult = 0.7f;
264                params.flickerRateMult = 0.3f;
265//              params.flickerRateMult = 0.05f;
266//              params.glowSizeMult = 3f;
267//              params.brightSpotFullFraction = 0.5f;
268                
269                params.movementDurOverride = Math.max(0.05f, dist / arcSpeed);
270                
271                float arcWidth = 40f + mult * 40f;
272                float explosionRadius = 40f + mult * 40f;
273                
274                //Color color = weapon.getSpec().getGlowColor();
275                Color color = RiftLightningEffect.RIFT_LIGHTNING_COLOR;
276                EmpArcEntityAPI arc = (EmpArcEntityAPI)engine.spawnEmpArcVisual(from, ship, point, null,
277                                arcWidth, // thickness
278                                color,
279                                new Color(255,255,255,255),
280                                params
281                                );
282                arc.setCoreWidthOverride(arcWidth / 2f);
283                
284                arc.setRenderGlowAtStart(false);
285                arc.setFadedOutAtStart(true);
286                arc.setSingleFlickerMode(true);
287
288                float volume = 0.75f + 0.25f * mult;
289                float pitch = 1f + 0.25f * (1f - mult);
290                Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("rift_lightning_fire", pitch, volume, from, ship.getVelocity());
291                
292                if (shroud != null) {
293                        DwellerShroudParams shroudParams = shroud.getShroudParams();
294                        params = new EmpArcParams();
295                        params.segmentLengthMult = 4f;
296                        params.glowSizeMult = 4f;
297                        params.flickerRateMult = 0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f;
298                        params.flickerRateMult *= 1.5f;
299                        
300                        //Color fringe = shroudParams.overloadArcFringeColor;
301                        Color fringe = color;
302                        Color core = Color.white;
303
304                        float thickness = shroudParams.overloadArcThickness;
305                        
306                        //Vector2f to = Misc.getPointAtRadius(from, 1f);
307                        
308                        float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(from, ship.getLocation());
309                        angle = angle + 90f * ((float) Math.random() - 0.5f);
310                        Vector2f dir = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
311                        dist = shroudParams.maxOffset * shroud.getShroudParams().overloadArcOffsetMult;
312                        dist = dist * 0.5f + dist * 0.5f * (float) Math.random();
313                        //dist *= 1.5f;
314                        dist *= 0.5f;
315                        dir.scale(dist);
316                        Vector2f to = Vector2f.add(from, dir, new Vector2f());
317                        
318                        arc = (EmpArcEntityAPI)engine.spawnEmpArcVisual(
319                                        from, ship, to, ship, thickness, fringe, core, params);
320                        
321                        arc.setCoreWidthOverride(shroudParams.overloadArcCoreThickness);
322                        arc.setSingleFlickerMode(false);
323                        //arc.setRenderGlowAtStart(false);
324                }
325                
326                
327                
328                float explosionDelay = params.movementDurOverride * 0.8f;
329                Global.getCombatEngine().addPlugin(new DelayedCombatActionPlugin(explosionDelay, new Runnable() {
330                        @Override
331                        public void run() {
332                                DamagingExplosionSpec spec = new DamagingExplosionSpec(
333                                                0.1f, // duration
334                                                explosionRadius, // radius
335                                                explosionRadius * 0.5f, // coreRadius
336                                                damage, // maxDamage
337                                                damage / 2f, // minDamage
338                                                CollisionClass.PROJECTILE_NO_FF, // collisionClass
339                                                CollisionClass.GAS_CLOUD, // collisionClassByFighter - using to flag it as from this effect
340                                                3f, // particleSizeMin
341                                                3f, // particleSizeRange
342                                                0.5f, // particleDuration
343                                                0, // particleCount
344                                                new Color(255,255,255,0), // particleColor
345                                                new Color(255,100,100,0)  // explosionColor
346                                                );
347                                spec.setMinEMPDamage(emp * 0.5f);
348                                spec.setMaxEMPDamage(emp);
349
350                                spec.setDamageType(DamageType.ENERGY);
351                                spec.setUseDetailedExplosion(false);
352                                spec.setSoundSetId("rift_lightning_explosion");
353                                spec.setSoundVolume(0.5f + 0.5f * mult);
354
355                                DamagingProjectileAPI explosion = engine.spawnDamagingExplosion(spec, ship, point);
356                                
357                                //explosion.addDamagedAlready(target);
358                                //color = new Color(255,75,75,255);
359
360                                //              float baseSize = 10f;
361                                //
362                                //              NEParams p = RiftCascadeMineExplosion.createStandardRiftParams(
363                                //                              color, baseSize);
364                                //              //p.hitGlowSizeMult = 0.5f;
365                                //              p.noiseMult = 6f;
366                                //              p.thickness = 25f;
367                                //              p.fadeOut = 0.5f;
368                                //              p.spawnHitGlowAt = 1f;
369                                //              p.additiveBlend = true;
370                                //              p.blackColor = Color.white;
371                                //              p.underglow = null;
372                                //              p.withNegativeParticles = false;
373                                //              p.withHitGlow = false;
374                                //              p.fadeIn = 0f;
375                                //              //p.numRiftsToSpawn = 1;
376                                //
377                                //              RiftCascadeMineExplosion.spawnStandardRift(explosion, p);
378
379                                Color color = RiftLightningEffect.RIFT_LIGHTNING_COLOR;
380                                color = new Color(255,75,75,255);
381                                NEParams p = RiftCascadeMineExplosion.createStandardRiftParams(
382                                                color, 14f + 6f * mult);
383                                p.fadeOut = 0.5f + 0.5f * mult;
384                                p.hitGlowSizeMult = 0.6f;
385                                p.thickness = 50f;
386                                //p.thickness = 25f;
387
388
389                                //              p.hitGlowSizeMult = 0.5f;
390                                //              p.thickness = 25f;
391                                //              p.fadeOut = 0.25f;
392
393                                RiftCascadeMineExplosion.spawnStandardRift(explosion, p);
394                        }
395                }));
396                
397        }

404        @Override
405        public void addPostDescriptionSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, HullSize hullSize, final ShipAPI ship, float width, boolean isForModSpec) {
406                float pad = 3f;
407                float opad = 10f;
408                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
409                Color bad = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
410                
411                
412                tooltip.addPara("Fires rift lightning bolts at locations recently hit by this ship's weapons.", opad);
413                
414                tooltip.addPara("The amount of damage and the flux generated depend on the size of the ship the "
415                                + "hullmod is installed on. The probability of a bolt being fired increases with the number "
416                                + "of hits landed over the previous %s seconds. "
417                                + "Bolts are not triggered by weapons dealing soft flux damage, such as beams.", opad,
418                                Misc.getHighlightColor(), "" + (int)Math.round(RECENT_HIT_DUR));
419                
420                //tooltip.addSectionHeading("Reload capacity", Alignment.MID, opad);
421                
422                if (isForModSpec || (ship == null && !Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE)) return;
423                
424                tooltip.setBgAlpha(0.9f);
425                
426                HullSize [] sizes = new HullSize[] {HullSize.FRIGATE, HullSize.DESTROYER, HullSize.CRUISER, HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP}; 
427                
428                float damW = 87f;
429                float empW = 87f;
430                float fluxW = 87f;
431                float sizeW = width - damW - empW - fluxW - 10f;
432                tooltip.beginTable(Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), Misc.getDarkPlayerColor(), Misc.getBrightPlayerColor(),
433                                   20f, true, true, 
434                                   new Object [] {"Ship size", sizeW, "Damage", damW, "EMP", empW, "Flux cost", fluxW});
435                
436                for (HullSize size : sizes) {
437                        float damage = getDamage(size);
438                        float emp = getEMPDamage(size);
439                        float fluxCost = getFluxCost(size);
440                        
441                        Color c = Misc.getGrayColor();
442                        if (size == hullSize || Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
443                                c = Misc.getHighlightColor();
444                        }
445                        tooltip.addRow(Alignment.MID, c, Misc.getHullSizeStr(size),
446                                                   Alignment.MID, c, "" + (int) Math.round(damage),
447                                                   Alignment.MID, c, "" + (int) Math.round(emp),
448                                                   Alignment.MID, c, "" + "" + (int) Math.round(fluxCost));
449                }
450                tooltip.addTable("", 0, opad);
451                
452                tooltip.addSpacer(5f);
453                
454                addCrewCasualties(tooltip, opad);
455                
456//              if (Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
457//                      return;
458//              }
459        }
